2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch breaks out the gup_lookup_pte() helper from the larger follow_page_pte() function in mm/gup.c. The new helper resolves a present PTE to the page it maps, returning NULL if the PTE cannot be followed or a negative errno if the caller must report failure. This change simplifies the code and reduces complexity by separating concerns. No functional changes are intended.
